message: 破滅を寿ぐ者

name: Helena
message: 「There are only two days left until the Holy Night Festival, so are the preparations going alright?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Completely ready! We've done all we can, so now we just leave it up to fate!」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka, you have your club activities to deal with too, don't you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Leave it to me! Everything's in the bag!」
Nanaka seemed unusually excited.

name: Helena
message: 「How about it, Student Council President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes. Preparations are going smoothly. Rehearsals for the parts hosted by the Student Council are finished. All that's left is the actual setup.」
I hope Nanaka isn't pushing herself too hard.

name: Ria
message: 「It's going even more smoothly than last year.」

name: Helena
message: 「In that case, you have a little bit of spare time, don't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「We do, yes.」

name: Helena
message: 「Splendid. Because--」
Helena paused for a moment and looked around at us.

name: Helena
message: 「There is an errand I'd like the members of the Student Council to take care of before the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ask anything of us! My Student Council is the greatest!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's mine!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's not yours either, Misa.」

name: Helena
message: 「None of you know why Pasta and the others were wandering around the academy at night, do you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I do know. It was on a whim.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They are Demons, after all. What a pain.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's what Big Sis said back then, but... I wasn't convinced.」

name: Synn
message: 「Neither was I.」

name: Misa
message: 「I thought that much through myself, too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey! That makes me look like an idiot for honestly believing it was just a whim!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hehe. You're quite the fool, Treasurer. Actually, I had my suspicions too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Traitor!」

name: Helena
message: 「You see, they were creating a giant magic circle large enough to cover the entirety of Ryuusei Town.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A ma-gic circle?」

name: Misa
message: 「Isn't that something you'd see in a fantasy story?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, that! Like the kind that pops up in video games! I never thought I'd hear a word like that in real life!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why would they make something like that?」

name: Helena
message: 「Simply put, to accelerate and amplify Re-Crea.」

name: Synn
message: 「Accelerate and amplify Re-Crea?」

name: Ria
message: 「No way! If they did something like that...」

name: Helena
message: 「The world would be destroyed.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Chairwoman! Didn't you just casually say something completely outrageous!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Surely not even they would go that far...」

name: Helena
message: 「Ryuusei Academy is built right next to the singularity connecting the Three Realms. In other words, it's the seam of space-time--and its weakest point.」

name: Helena
message: 「That's why Demons have appeared here since ancient times, and why the Kujou family and the Crusaders existed to protect it.」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's how it is!」

name: Helena
message: 「If the space-time distortion caused by Re-Crea is amplified here, the impact on the Three Realms will be catastrophic.」

name: Helena
message: 「Once the balance collapses, it'll trigger Pre-Materialize--well, the terminology doesn't really matter. Point is, the Three Realms will collapse in a chain reaction.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-Are you serious!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Unfortunately, dead serious.」

name: Ria
message: 「How can we destroy the magic circle?」

name: Helena
message: 「Too bad, but it's impossible for anyone without specialized knowledge. And the one in charge of destroying the magic circle for us was Melilot.」
So that's why Melilot-san was walking around the academy at night.
When Azel said something was being destroyed, did she mean the magic circle?

name: Helena
message: 「If Soltia appeared to interfere with destroying the magic circle, Melilot would take her down」

name: Helena
message: 「And the plan was for the Crusaders to fight the remaining Virus with Melilot's support」

name: Helena
message: 「It was an operation with a 79.8% success rate, but... things suddenly started going off the rails」

name: Helena
message: 「The magic circle Pasta and the others made had an angel's seal on it to prevent destruction」

name: Synn
message: 「An angel's seal?」

name: Helena
message: 「Because it's a special seal woven from Spirit Power, destroying it gave Melilot, being a demon, quite a bit of trouble」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're quite ignorant, Chairwoman. That's impossible.」

name: Helena
message: 「Why?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Only we angels can create an angel's seal. Angels do not cooperate with demons. Therefore, such a thing is impossible.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone, please don't be shocked. I am actually an angel! Since an angel is saying it, there's no mistake!」

name: Helena
message: 「Setting Lolotte's true identity aside for a moment」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You just brushed right past that!?」
If it's them, maybe even the fact that I'm the Demon King... But...
What would Nanaka think?

name: Helena
message: 「As long as the seal exists, there's an angel cooperating with Pasta and the others. If it isn't Lolotte, then it can only be Azel, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even so, an angel cooperating with demons is unthinkable.」

name: Ria
message: 「Azel...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way! That can't be! She's our classmate!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Doubt she thinks of you guys that way」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, sure, she completely ignored me whenever I tried talking to her, but...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I won't believe it until I see the seal for myself!」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, the Chairwoman has no reason to lie...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe I should've tried talking to her a bit more... Could she have mistaken it for bullying or something!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not a chance」

name: Misa
message: 「So that's why! That's why she was spotted at the academy at night」

name: Synn
message: 「Then that means Azel and Sengenin Se--Soltia and Virus are working together……」
That doesn't make sense.
Sure, Virus and Azel did seem like they knew each other.
But if so, why did Virus protect me last night?

name: Misa
message: 「I don't see anything strange about it, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Why do you think it's strange, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, that's--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To begin with, Azel-san would never team up with people like them!」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot and I thought Virus was the mastermind, and Soltia and Pasta-chan were cooperating with him.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've got it! Azel-san was being blackmailed!」
Someone with as much power as Azel being blackmailed?
Something really isn't adding up……

name: Nanaka
message: 「Could it be…… now that the magic circle is complete and she's outlived her usefulness, they're going to--」

name: Misa
message: 「This is bad!」

name: Ria
message: 「We have to save Azel-san!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But where on earth could she be……」

name: Helena
message: 「It doesn't seem like she's being forced to cooperate, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh…… but then--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That makes even less sense!」

name: Helena
message: 「Nobody should be able to blackmail Azel-chan. After all, Azel-chan is Re-Crea itself.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Re-Crea itself!?」
Melilot-san really did say that. That Azel is Re-Crea.

name: Helena
message: 「Azel-chan harbors the power of Re-Crea inside her body. There's no mistake about it.」
Saying that, Helena-san took a single photograph from the director's desk.

name: Ria
message: 「What is this……?」

name: Helena
message: 「It's a photo taken last night during the battle between Melilot and Azel-chan.」
Even through an image, a sinister aura presses in on me.

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is…… Azel-san…… An angel's power wouldn't look like this……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, so Azel is our enemy!? Seriously!?」

name: Ria
message: 「No way. I mean, it's Azel we're talking about, right? Sure, we never got all that close, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「Then he took out Melilot to stop any more magic circles from being destroyed?」

name: Helena
message: 「If she were up against Soltia, Melilot wouldn't have fallen behind, though...」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-This... isn't special effects?」

name: Helena
message: 「It's real. Most of the monitors blew out from overload, so this is all we managed to capture.」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm sure you've all seen magic power swirling around Demon Generals and demons before.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes.」

name: Helena
message: 「You can only see that because you're under the influence of Guardian Angels--normally, it's invisible. Yet it showed up clearly on an ordinary monitor.」

name: Ria
message: 「Meaning his power is just that off the charts...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Exactly. Power that's supposed to be invisible is so dense it's reached the level of pseudo-matter.」

name: Helena
message: 「Who would've thought... It wasn't Virus, but Re-Crea itself that was our enemy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on a second! What about Melilot? What happened after she fought Azel!?」

name: Helena
message: 「She lost. She burned through every last drop of magic in her body, and she's still in a coma.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No way...」

name: Helena
message: 「She'll be fine. She should regain consciousness in about a week.」

name: Misa
message: 「To think even Melilot... was defeated...」

name: Ria
message: 「What is Re-Crea's--no, Azel's goal...?」

name: Helena
message: 「The destruction of this world.」

name: Helena
message: 「According to Melilot, it's to remake this world. At least, that's how the angels' teachings put it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Angels are way crazier than demons!」

name: Ria
message: 「Is that true, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...It is true that in our God's teachings, there is a passage stating that Re-Crea is the manifestation of God's will to remake the world.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But... I didn't think anyone actually believed it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「So it's a crusade to destroy this tainted world and bring about a new one, huh. Fanatics are the worst kind of trouble」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What the heck is that! Don't pull something like that right before the Holy Night Festival!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even though I still... haven't been able to do anything...」

name: Misa
message: 「Then, does that mean the true mastermind was Azel-san, and Virus, Sengen'in-sensei, and Pasta-san were merely being used?」

name: Helena
message: 「I wonder about that. They probably each had their own agendas.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san is a fool. To betray her friends over something like this! It is unbelievable!」

name: Paqy
message: 「She probably didn't think of it that way」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Panda-san, please be quiet. To think Azel-san was such a delinquent!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We must have the Archangel give her a spanking!」

name: Paqy
message: 「There've been a dime a dozen fanatics since the old days, yeah, but none of 'em could actually use the power of Re-Crea」

name: Synn
message: 「So this is the worst-case scenario?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pretty much」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot had considered every possibility, and anticipated that a situation like this could happen.」
Helena-san took a bound report out of her desk drawer.

name: Helena
message: 「Specifically, the scenario where as of last night, she herself was defeated, seventy percent of the magic circle's functions remained intact, and it retained enough capacity to accelerate and strengthen Re-Crea.」

name: Helena
message: 「Re-Crea will occur and spacetime will begin to collapse on December 24th at 4:23:28 AM. Margin of error within two minutes.」

name: Helena
message: 「In all likelihood, Azel-chan, the core of Re-Crea itself, will appear at the same time. The location is the plaza beneath Finis Tower, where the most critical magic circle closest to the singularity was set up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... that's... the errand you wanted us to take care of before the Holy Night Festival?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right. Don't worry, you can win. At least, that's what Melilot left written down.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is there some kind of good plan?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It must be intensive training known as cramming overnight! I shall do ten thousand bunny hops and snap my Achilles tendons! Gogogogogogo」

name: Misa
message: 「You mustn't snap them!」

name: Helena
message: 「Apparently, there's nothing more you need to do. Just go ahead and prepare for the Holy Night Festival.」
Helena-san glanced over at me.

name: Helena
message: 「'If everyone trusts one another and draws out their full potential, it won't just add up to 5--it could become 10, 100, or even 1,000,' apparently.」
Is she talking about me? About how I can't become a complete Demon Lord.

name: Helena
message: 「So anyway, I know it's sudden right before the Holy Night Festival, but I'm counting on you.」
